summary.key_theme: 科技股面臨資本支出競賽壓力與市場去槓桿化風險，導致 QQQ 近期表現疲軟且市場情緒轉趨謹慎。

bullish.title: Aggressive Buying On Nvidia Backing Massive OpenAI Data Center And Trump Pausing Iran Attacks
bullish.reason: 市場對於 Nvidia 等 AI 龍頭股的積極買盤，為 QQQ 的科技權重股提供了支撐力道。

bearish.title: Citadel, Situational Awareness, And The Likely Pause Of Forced Selling
bearish.reason: 指出科技股面臨去槓桿化與強制賣壓，且聯準會政策不確定性增加，對 QQQ 構成顯著下行壓力。

bearish.title: QQQI’s 14% Yield Hides a Costly Truth: 98% Is Your Own Money Coming Back
bearish.reason: 揭露衍生性商品 ETF 的高配息結構隱憂，提醒投資人高殖利率可能源自本金返還，影響投資信心。

bearish.title: Daily Breadth Rebounds, but the Negative Bias Remains
bearish.reason: 綜合多篇技術分析指出 QQQ 走勢疲軟，且市場參與度低於 50%，顯示整體趨勢偏向負面。

bearish.title: QQQ And Tech Earnings: They Can't All Win The CapEx Arms Race
bearish.reason: 分析指出大型科技股在 AI 領域的資本支出競賽過於激烈，恐壓縮未來獲利空間。

bearish.title: SPYG Vs. QQQ: It's Not The Tech Exposure, It's What's Inside It
bearish.reason: 建議投資人轉向風險調整後表現更佳的替代標的，暗示 QQQ 在當前環境下風險較高。

neutral.title: BlackRock’s Nasdaq ETF Challenger Is Growing — But QQQ Still Pulls 300× More Inflows
neutral.reason: 雖然競爭對手 ETF 資金流入增加，但 QQQ 仍保持絕對市場主導地位，對股價影響中性。

neutral.title: Trump Says US Should Have the World's Lowest Interest Rates: What Do Prediction Markets Say?
neutral.reason: 討論利率政策對市場的潛在影響，但目前僅為市場預測，尚未形成實質利多或利空。
